investigation_notes.Related Alert: SOC-1988 (2026-01-04) — similar Get-ADGroup GUID lookup by j.smith closed as false positive after IT verification that this was a manual audit by a Senior Systems Administrator.
investigation_notes.Description: A PowerShell command performing an Active Directory group lookup by ObjectGUID was executed by j.smith on MGMT-TERM-01. A near-identical alert (SOC-1988) was previously closed as a false positive after IT confirmed this user is a Senior Systems Administrator conducting manual audits. There are no file paths, process hashes, external IPs, or other malicious indicators present in the provided evidence. Based on the administrative account, benign script intent, and prior verified activity, this alert is considered Low Priority.
